text:
morgan: heads up — staging publish for redwood/runtime:2026.03 failed the registry parity check. deploy-bot rejected the push.
lee_o: deploy-bot message pasted below (from the push job).
deploy-bot: [automated] publish blocked for repo=redwood/runtime tag=2026.03-staging reason=manifest-label-mismatch expected(buildid)=abc123 actual(buildid)=def456
carlos: ugh, label got flipped in the last build step. probably the new metadata injector ran in the wrong order.
morgan: can we pin canary to the last-good digest so the canary app stays healthy? we should avoid a rollback of the entire release if possible. :pray:
rita.k: +1. plan: retag previous digest as 2026.03-staging and force the deploybot to accept it. i can do the retag if infra gives thumbs up.
anika: if we pin, we should also attach a short release note explaining why we pinned and that the pipeline fix is coming. ops wants traceability.
lee_o: approved. do the retag and then create a follow-up PR to the pipeline repo that adds a manifest-label sanity step before injecting metadata.
morgan: retag commands i'm going to run (on a temporary machine):
```
# fetch the digest from registry
REPO=us-west1-docker.pkg.redwood/runtime
OLD_DIGEST=sha256:4f2a9c7b5d6e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
# retag locally then push the tag pointing to the same digest
docker pull $REPO@$OLD_DIGEST
docker tag $REPO@$OLD_DIGEST $REPO:2026.03-staging
docker push $REPO:2026.03-staging
# notify deploy-bot to re-evaluate
# (deploy-bot will accept if manifest labels match expected pattern)
```
rita.k: i'll shadow the push and watch smoke tests. can someone @eng-infra look at the pipeline PR after i push?
carlos: i'll open the infra ticket and add logs. ticket: INFRA-4681 — pipeline metadata injector ordering.
deploy-bot: [automated] image pinned: redwood/runtime:2026.03-staging -> sha256:4f2a9c7b5d6e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890. canary redeploy triggered.
morgan: canary redeploy looks green so far (smoke pass). will follow up with a short note in the release channel. :thumbsup:
lee_o: thanks all. next steps: (1) PR to pipeline to add label preflight check (2) infra ticket INFRA-4681 for ordering and a short postmortem (3) release note entry that we pinned image for canary and plan to re-run publish after pipeline fix.
anika: adding release-note blurb now.
morgan: closing thread — will ping when pipeline PR merges and when we re-run build.
